title: Pay customs duty on imported goods
what: Customs duty is imposed on goods imported into Australia at the rates in the tariff.

sources.title: Customs Tariff Act 1995
sources.quote: 15 Imposition of duties Duties of Customs are imposed by this Act on: (a) goods imported into Australia on or after 1 July 1996; and (b) goods: (i) imported into Australia before 1 July 1996; and (ii) entered, or again entered, for home consumption on or after that day.
